Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Initial release: HVSC Multi-SID Address Scanner

A command-line tool to scan the High Voltage SID Collection for multi-SID
tunes and extract SID chip addresses from PSID/RSID file headers.

Features:
- Scans for 2SID, 3SID, 4SID files
- Extracts addresses from PSID v3/v4 headers
- Outputs CSV with metadata \(title, author, addresses\)
- Shows summary statistics by type and address configuration
- Zero dependencies \(pure Python stdlib\)

Includes sample output from HVSC #84 scan \(341 multi-SID files\).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
